title: Zhang-2026-fine-10.1038/s41597-026-07619-z
description: This dataset provides electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from patients at Huashan Hospital during speech perception in a tonal language. The signal is the high-gamma envelope (70-150 Hz Hilbert transform) rather than raw voltage, converted from NWB to EDF in BIDS format. It supports fine-grained spatiotemporal analysis of neural responses to tonal speech.
methods_description: Intracranial ECoG was recorded during a speech perception task, with participants giving informed consent the day before surgery. The authors' 70-150 Hz Hilbert high-gamma envelope was exported from NWB to EDF in microvolts, with round-trip conversion error reported per file.
